description: This file defines a PHP interface named SchedulerConfigurationInterface within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically in the console scheduling module. It declares a single method 'schedule' which accepts a Schedule object, indicating the contract for scheduling configurations in the system.

classes.name: SchedulerConfigurationInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface that mandates implementing a 'schedule' function accepting a Schedule object, used for configuring scheduled tasks in the system.

methods.name: schedule
